title: Fix MKV ASS language-preserve routing
summary: Prevent MKV ASS tracks retained only by forced/SDH metadata from entering ASS-to-SRT conversion, while preserving preferred-language ASS conversion and original ASS carry-forward.
reason: A non-preferred-language ASS track could bypass the language filter because it was forced or SDH, then be routed as ConvertAss because routing did not know whether the language policy itself matched. MKV outputs should preserve those original ASS tracks rather than generating unwanted non-English SRT conversions.
behavior_before: Forced or SDH ASS subtitles outside the configured ASS keep languages were retained, then treated as conversion candidates and could produce non-English SRT output. MKV conversion decisions already supported original ASS preservation, but the routing step could put the wrong tracks into conversion.
behavior_after: Subtitle policy records whether a retained track matched the language conversion policy. Filtering carries that evidence forward, and ASS routing keeps non-policy forced/SDH ASS tracks as originals while preferred-language ASS remains conversion-eligible. MKV ASS conversion decisions continue to preserve the original ASS when DropAssAfterConversion is false.
tests_added: Added coverage for non-policy forced ASS retained as original, preferred-language ASS conversion, and MKV ASS original preservation.
